judged_text: iframe.src is built as discourseUrl + "embed/best?..." which silently requires the embedded discourseUrl to end with a trailing slash, and neither the snippet nor the code validates or normalizes it. A site owner who pastes their forum URL without the trailing slash gets iframe.src like "https://forum.example.comembed/best?...", the iframe 404s forever, and the comments simply never appear with no error message pointing at the misconfiguration.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, `iframe.src` is constructed via string concatenation: `discourseUrl + "embed/best?..."` with no normalization/guard to ensure `discourseUrl` ends in `/`. If `discourseUrl` is provided as `https://forum.example.com` (no trailing slash), the resulting URL becomes `https://forum.example.comembed/best?...`, which would break embedding. The diff shows no validation or correction for this assumption.
